verdict.rationale: Edge0 is an on-device model runtime with mobile and desktop apps, so on-device real-time speech transcription is a fair capability to ask about. However, the evidence covers only text LLM inference (MoE expert offload, LoRA adapters, and an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint). Nothing in the pack mentions speech input, dictation, or a transcription model.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model
